name: io.github.KarvedConcepts/karved-quotes
title: Karved Concepts quotes and mockups
description: Custom printed drinkware: designs, price estimates, blank fit checks, mockups, quote requests.

tools.name: search_designs
tools.description: Karved's own ready-made cup designs (gifts, hobbies, jobs, holidays, full wraps) matching the words given. Returns title, product page url, price per cup, image and a short description. The art is fixed; many designs take an optional name on the product page, and the name is included in the price. We email a proof before printing and it ships in 5 business days. Send the customer the url to buy.

query.description: What the customer wants, e.g. "nurse gift", "camo", "funny golf"

tools.name: list_cups
tools.description: The cups you can design on: blank_shape_id, name, colours, print coverages, fonts, and product/quote handoff links. Call this first.

tools.name: estimate_price
tools.description: Artwork-free retail price estimate for Karved cups (1-49 posted online price; 50+ retail list bulk price, anchors at 50/100/250/500). Customer-supplied blank decoration (50+ minimum) returns quote_required: it is quoted per job. Returns pre-filled builder/quote handoff links. Never includes shipping.

supplied_blank.description: Set true when the customer supplies their own blanks (50-piece / $100 minimum)

blank_shape_id.description: Cup id from list_cups (required unless supplied_blank is true)

surface_tone.description: Surface tone when colour is omitted (default dark / white base)

own_artwork.description: True (default) for customer logo/art ($40.75 art prep & proof once per design); false for text-only ($0 online for 1-49 cups; 50+ estimates include the $40.75 once per design); a full wrap without own artwork is quoted

tools.name: check_supplied_blank_fit
tools.description: Check whether a customer-supplied drinkware item, bottle, jar, or tin fits Karved's published UV printing limits (40-120 mm round, no handles, glass/ceramic/plastic/coated metal, 50-piece / $100 minimum) and return the fit-check handoff link.

diameter_mm.description: Diameter across the print zone in millimeters

material.description: e.g. stainless, powder_coat, glass, ceramic, plastic, coated_metal, tin, aluminum

has_handle.description: True if the item has a handle (not supported for supplied-blank UV)

is_smoking_or_vape.description: True if smoking or vape hardware (not printed)

qty.description: Optional run quantity to check against the 50-piece minimum

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Put the customer's logo (and up to 2 text lines) on a cup. Returns design_id, design_version, an artwork check (preflight) and a mockup_url. Upload the customer's own file as base64 (PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF, up to 25 MB). Partner agent keys may pass an idempotency_key so a retry does not make a second design.

colour.description: A colour slug from list_cups for that cup

coverage.description: Print coverage offered on that cup (list_cups)

wrap_height.description: full_wrap on a cup with grip ribs (20oz Ringneck, 16oz Pint): above_ribs (default, the ribs stay the cup colour) or to_base (over the ribs)

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The posted price for a quantity of this design (cups + art prep fee, no shipping). For 50 or more, full wraps not sold online, or business accounts it returns quote_required: then use request_quote.

tools.name: get_mockup
tools.description: A mockup image URL of the design on the cup, optionally in another colour of the same cup. A preview, not a proof.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request to Karved with the customer's contact details — works either with a design_id from create_design OR without uploaded artwork yet (pass blank_shape_id or item_description, or supplied_blank: true). Only call it after the customer agreed. Our team replies by email within one business day. Nothing is charged, ordered, or emailed automatically.

supplied_blank.description: True when quoting decoration on customer-supplied blanks (50+ pieces)

blank_shape_id.description: Cup id from list_cups (when no design_id is supplied)

item_description.description: Item / vessel description when no design_id is supplied (or for supplied blanks)

artwork_status.description: e.g. "will email logo", "needs design from scratch"

needed_by.description: The date or event, in the customer's words
